messages:
Ethan: Hi folks! Ethan here, started this morning. Quick environment snag: after running the dotfiles bootstrap my PATH has two asdf installs and brew is the Intel one under /usr/local. Im on an M1 Mac. Any safe steps to consolidate without nuking configs?

claire: welcome Ethan :wave: You probably have an old Homebrew from before the Apple Silicon move. First, check `which brew` and `brew --prefix`. If it returns /usr/local, reinstall Homebrew to /opt/homebrew following brew.sh.

Ethan: ok, I ran the new install but my .zprofile still sources /usr/local stuff. Is it safe to remove the old Homebrew folder?

claire: don't delete straight away. Update your shell files: remove references to /usr/local from ~/.zprofile and add `eval "$( $(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew --prefix)/bin/brew shellenv)"`. Then open a new shell and verify `brew --prefix` points to /opt/homebrew. Once everything works and you moved packages over, you can archive /usr/local (tar it) before deleting.

ops-bot: note: created infra ticket ONB-540 for brew migration help.

Ethan: thanks. Another problem: asdf shows two installations in ~/.asdf and /usr/local/opt/asdf. Which should I keep?

rahul: keep the one in your home dir (~/.asdf). The system one may be leftover from a package manager. Remove the /usr/local/opt/asdf symlink and ensure `~/.asdf/bin` is in PATH before other entries. Check `asdf where nodejs` after installing plugins.

Ethan: after fixing PATH, do I need to reinstall language versions? I had Python 3.10 and node 16 installed earlier.

claire: generally yes for node/python native builds because they link to the openssl/readline from brew location which changed. After brew switch, reinstall versions: `asdf uninstall python 3.10.12` then `asdf install python 3.10.12` (or just `asdf reshim` sometimes works). Make sure you `brew install openssl@1.1 readline xz zlib` first and export build flags if compile errors appear.

Ethan: last Q: my SSH key isn't yet approved for org repos. I added it to GitHub. How long till access?

ops-bot: infra note: added Ethan to onboarding queue. Once public key is visible, infra will grant repo access; allow up to 30 mins for automated sync. If you need immediate access DM @rahul for expedited request.

Ethan: awesome, thanks all. Ill follow steps and ping if something breaks. Appreciate the quick help!
